profile.reading: This OpenStreetMap-mapped point is attributed to CyrusOne and sits at Pierce Street, Franklin Township, Somerset County, New Jersey 08873, per an OpenStreetMap Nominatim reverse geocode of its stored coordinates. CyrusOne's own site discloses one facility in the Somerset, New Jersey area, branded NYM1, with a confirmed street address of 800 Cottontail Ln, Somerset, NJ 08873, tracked separately in this registry at cyrusone:somerset-nj; that address does not match this row's reverse-geocoded Pierce Street location. This session attempted to resolve whether the two records represent the same physical facility by reverse geocoding this row's own coordinates through two independent services: geocode.xyz, which remained throttled (a persistent pattern observed repeatedly across this registry's CyrusOne research), and OpenStreetMap Nominatim, which refused a fresh repeat request under its robots.txt rate-limiting rules, leaving the earlier single Nominatim result as the only geocoding evidence on file. Given the mismatch between this row's Pierce Street location and NYM1's confirmed Cottontail Lane address, this session does not assert this row is the same facility as NYM1, nor does it assert a specific CyrusOne facility code, MW figure, or square footage for this row; it remains an honest short entry citing what a real geocoding record shows, rather than a fabricated match to fill out the fact-box. A future researcher with parcel-level records or Somerset County assessor data could resolve whether this is a genuinely separate, currently undocumented CyrusOne site or a duplicate map entity with imprecise coordinates.

reading.body:
CyrusOne operates a facility in Somerset County, New Jersey under the brand NYM1, located in Franklin Township. No power capacity, floor area, or opening date is published for this campus. The operator is a major US data center company, currently owned by Kohlberg Kravis Roberts and Global Infrastructure Partners following a 2022 acquisition, but facility-specific investment or operational details for this site are not available.

Among New Jersey's 48 mapped data center facilities, only 5 publish power capacity figures, totaling 111.3 MW across the state. This Somerset campus would rank sixth by published capacity if its power draw were disclosed, but capacity is not published. Without a published figure, its scale relative to other New Jersey facilities cannot be determined.

The certifications held by this campus are not published. The site's significance to AI infrastructure depends entirely on undisclosed specifications. To assess whether CyrusOne Somerset matters to the grid constraint on AI scaling, readers will need to source power capacity and cooling infrastructure directly from the operator.
